scope: Americas, Africa and Middle East: 23 assigned countries; curated 4–6 institutional/general/economic anchors each.

methodology.selection: Primary publisher identity/role and primary 2026 Reuters Institute market context where available; no exhaustive census or unverified numerical rankings.
methodology.matching: Exact publisher domain/subdomain matches with explicit commercial-feed/path aliases; country-specific scopes retained. Missing is configuration absence, not failure.
methodology.enabled: Absent/null enabled flag is normalized active; only explicit false is disabled, matching existing registry behavior.
methodology.endpoint_policy: No XML fetches, guessed endpoints, bulk crawl, model calls, auto-reactivation, registration edits or deployments. endpoint_candidate is null unless an exact official declaration URL is known.
